title_zh: 五同会图 (Five Commonalities Society painting)
medium: handscroll, ink and colors on silk
notes: Court painters Lu Ji and Lu Wenying depicted the five Suzhou officials including Wu Kuan. This is a group scene, not an individual portrait likeness.

title_en: Later imagined portrait of Wu Kuan
notes: No verified contemporary individual portrait of Wu Kuan confirmed. Any circulating portrait is likely a later imagined depiction.
